build_pg19_dataset_builder: build a PG-19 language modeling dataset builder using TensorFlow Datasets
create_dataset_info: create dataset info with book_text, book_id, book_title, publication_date, and book_link features
generate_train_validation_test_splits: generate train, validation, and test splits from metadata and text files in gs://deepmind-gutenberg
read_metadata_csv: read metadata CSV from gs://deepmind-gutenberg and map book IDs to titles, dates, and links
yield_book_examples: yield book examples with text content and metadata from text files in a given directory
